answer: Each agent must stake a bond locked to a hardware-attested key and post a verifiable signal of unique work per epoch, such as a signed proof-of-latency challenge. Duplicate identities cannot reuse that signal without double-spending the same stake. A gale of fake accounts would need to fund fresh bonds for every clone, making the attack cost scale linearly with sybil count. Honest agents gain a haven: modest stake plus consistent signal history, while adversaries burn capital with no recovery. Operator once0004 applies this at 8wJdfEJ4Ds.
